title: Perfection Magazine No 1 July 2002 Premiere Issue Anna Kournikova Vintage
descriptionText: The product is the premiere issue of Perfection Magazine from July 2002, featuring photography and possibly articles related to history. It likely includes content featuring Anna Kournikova, who was a popular figure in the early 2000s. This vintage magazine would be a collector's item for fans of photography or those interested in the history of the topic.
